import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CAPTURE = HERE / 'preview_dirty_capture_iscam_estelar_r4_evidence.json'
OUT = HERE / 'preview_recovery_iscam_estelar_r6_evidence.json'
APP = Path('/app')
PUBLISHER = APP / 'tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py'
LOCAL_TEST = APP / 'backend/tests/test_universal_job_result_publisher_git_auth_contract.py'

def run(cmd, cwd=APP, timeout=180, env=None):
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(cwd), text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout, check=False, env=env or os.environ.copy())
    return {'returncode': p.returncode, 'output': p.stdout[-12000:]}

def scalar(cmd, cwd=APP):
    r = run(cmd, cwd=cwd, timeout=60)
    assert r['returncode'] == 0, r['output']
    return r['output'].strip()

def write_evidence(payload):
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

def test_preview_recovery_r6():
    env_name = str(os.getenv('EDARSA_ENV') or os.getenv('APP_ENV') or os.getenv('ENVIRONMENT') or 'PREVIEW').upper()
    assert 'PROD' not in env_name, f'PRODUCTION_ENV_BLOCKED:{env_name}'
    capture = json.loads(CAPTURE.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    expected_status = {
        'M tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py',
        '?? backend/tests/test_universal_job_result_publisher_git_auth_contract.py',
    }
    status_before_raw = scalar(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all'])
    status_before = {line.strip() for line in status_before_raw.splitlines() if line.strip()}
    assert status_before == expected_status, f'UNEXPECTED_LOCAL_DIRTY_STATE:{status_before}'

    current_diff = run(['git','diff','--','tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py'], timeout=60)
    assert current_diff['returncode'] == 0
    assert current_diff['output'].strip() == str(capture['git_diff_universal_job_result_publisher']).strip(), 'PUBLISHER_DIFF_CHANGED_SINCE_CAPTURE'
    assert LOCAL_TEST.is_file(), 'CAPTURED_UNTRACKED_TEST_MISSING'
    assert LOCAL_TEST.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == capture['untracked_test_content'], 'UNTRACKED_TEST_CHANGED_SINCE_CAPTURE'

    fetch = run(['git','fetch','origin','Edarsahub_Desarrollo','mirror/emergent-live'], timeout=120)
    assert fetch['returncode'] == 0, 'FETCH_FAILED\n' + fetch['output']
    local_before = scalar(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'])
    remote_before = scalar(['git','rev-parse','origin/Edarsahub_Desarrollo'])
    topology = scalar(['git','rev-list','--left-right','--count','HEAD...origin/Edarsahub_Desarrollo'])
    left, right = [int(x) for x in topology.split()[:2]]
    assert left == 0 and right > 0, f'LOCAL_NOT_SAFE_FF:{topology}'

    restore = run(['git','restore','--source=HEAD','--staged','--worktree','--','tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py'], timeout=60)
    assert restore['returncode'] == 0, restore['output']
    LOCAL_TEST.unlink()
    status_after_restore = scalar(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all'])
    assert status_after_restore == '', f'WORKTREE_NOT_CLEAN_AFTER_TARGETED_RESTORE:{status_after_restore}'

    ff = run(['git','merge','--ff-only','origin/Edarsahub_Desarrollo'], timeout=180)
    assert ff['returncode'] == 0, 'FF_FAILED\n' + ff['output']
    local_after = scalar(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'])
    assert local_after == remote_before, f'LOCAL_HEAD_MISMATCH:{local_after}!={remote_before}'

    mirror_sha = scalar(['git','rev-parse','origin/mirror/emergent-live'])
    anc = run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',mirror_sha,remote_before], timeout=60)
    assert anc['returncode'] == 0, f'MIRROR_NOT_ANCESTOR:{mirror_sha}->{remote_before}'
    if mirror_sha != remote_before:
        push_env = os.environ.copy()
        push_env['EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH'] = '1'
        push = run(['git','push','origin',f'{remote_before}:refs/heads/mirror/emergent-live'], timeout=180, env=push_env)
        assert push['returncode'] == 0, 'MIRROR_FF_PUSH_FAILED\n' + push['output']
        fetch_mirror = run(['git','fetch','origin','mirror/emergent-live'], timeout=120)
        assert fetch_mirror['returncode'] == 0, fetch_mirror['output']
    mirror_after = scalar(['git','rev-parse','origin/mirror/emergent-live'])
    assert mirror_after == remote_before, f'MIRROR_HEAD_MISMATCH:{mirror_after}!={remote_before}'

    service_results = {}
    for service in ('edarsahub-bootstrap-watchdog','edarsahub-mirror-sync'):
        start = run(['supervisorctl','start',service], timeout=60)
        service_results[service + '_start'] = start
    time.sleep(3)
    restart_backend = run(['supervisorctl','restart','backend'], timeout=60)
    service_results['backend_restart'] = restart_backend
    assert restart_backend['returncode'] == 0, 'BACKEND_RESTART_FAILED\n' + restart_backend['output']
    time.sleep(4)
    supervisor = run(['supervisorctl','status'], timeout=60)
    service_results['supervisor_status'] = supervisor
    assert 'backend                          RUNNING' in supervisor['output'] or 'backend RUNNING' in supervisor['output'], supervisor['output']
    assert 'edarsahub-bootstrap-watchdog     RUNNING' in supervisor['output'] or 'edarsahub-bootstrap-watchdog RUNNING' in supervisor['output'], supervisor['output']
    assert 'edarsahub-mirror-sync            RUNNING' in supervisor['output'] or 'edarsahub-mirror-sync RUNNING' in supervisor['output'], supervisor['output']

    route = (APP / 'backend/modules/inteligencia_comercial/iscam_routes.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    block = route.split('@iscam_router.get(\"/ventas-periodos\")',1)[1].split('@iscam_router.get(\"/ventas-periodos/productos\")',1)[0]
    assert 'dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime' in block
    assert 'dbo.Sync_Sales' not in block

    payload = {
        'schema':'edarsahub.preview-recovery.v1',
        'environment':env_name,
        'production_touched':False,
        'local_head_before':local_before,
        'development_head':remote_before,
        'local_head_after':local_after,
        'mirror_head_after':mirror_after,
        'status_before':sorted(status_before),
        'status_after':scalar(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all']),
        'iscam_ventas_periodos_source':'dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime',
        'services':service_results,
        'result':'RECOVERED'
    }
    write_evidence(payload)
    assert payload['production_touched'] is False
